decisions.reason: This complex sports system is outside the firm's style-oriented core, carries high costs, and with many other options the firm should drop it.
As a mobile arena floor system it is expensive to maintain relative to its uncertain demand, making the option too costly to keep.
Parallel to B, this arena system has high carrying costs and uncertain prospects, so the option no longer justifies further commitment.
The flagship chevron parquet closely aligns with the firm's direction, has low incremental carrying cost, and retains option value, so keep.
The squash court finish is a low-cost niche option whose demand is still uncertain, so the option is worth more than its carrying cost.
The oak skirting is a low-cost accessory with unresolved prospects, making it a cheap option worth keeping.
